Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Introduction
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
 Your Role And Responsibilities
 As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and industrializing AI use cases within a Use Case Squad, utilizing an agentic approach. Your primary focus will be on translating business requirements into operational agent architectures, consuming services exposed by the Platform Squad or ITG. You will leverage your expertise in machine learning engineering, LLM/RAG, and agentic AI orchestration to deploy production AI solutions and translate business requirements into scalable AI applications.
 Preferred Education
 Master's Degree
 Required Technical And Professional Expertise
Strong proficiency in Python and experience with REST APIs
Familiarity with Git and MLflow (or equivalent)
Good knowledge of LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and similar frameworks
Ability to translate business requirements into operational agent architectures
Experience with machine learning engineering and agentic AI orchestration
Fluent French and English speaking and writing skills for interaction with business stakeholders
 Preferred Technical And Professional Experience
Experience with Kubernetes
Familiarity with Docker and OpenShift
Experience deploying production AI solutions
Knowledge of cloud-based technologies and containerization
